description: This file declares the GstProtectionMetadataWrapperFactory class, which implements the IGstProtectionMetadataWrapperFactory interface for creating GstProtectionMetadataWrapper instances. It is part of the firebolt::rialto::server namespace and includes a factory method that takes a shared pointer to an IGstWrapper.

classes.name: GstProtectionMetadataWrapperFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating GstProtectionMetadataWrapper objects, implementing the IGstProtectionMetadataWrapperFactory interface.

methods.name: createProtectionMetadataWrapper
methods.description: Creates and returns a unique pointer to an IGstProtectionMetadataWrapper, using the provided IGstWrapper shared pointer.
